federal_muni_harm_25.title: GERDA federal elections at municipality level, harmonized to 2025 boundaries
federal_muni_harm_25.description: German federal election results mapped to stable 2025 municipality boundaries. Party results are vote shares stored as proportions.

license.notice: Public launch is blocked until the GERDA maintainers publish an explicit reuse statement for this dataset.

citation.text: Heddesheimer, Vincent, Hanno Hilbig, Florian Sichart, and Andreas Wiedemann. 2025. GERDA: The German Election Database. Scientific Data 12: 618.

usage_notes: Use this harmonized dataset for comparisons over time on stable 2025 municipality boundaries.
AGS, state, and county identifiers are strings; leading zeros are significant.
Party values and turnout are proportions from 0 to 1, not percentages.
The federal municipality files use number_voters as the denominator for party vote shares.
caveats: Joint mail-in voting district results are allocated to municipalities using polling-card voter weights.
Boundary harmonization uses population and related crosswalk weights and can create small rounding discrepancies.
Quality-flag columns identify unsuccessful naive merges, turnout corrections, and vote-total discrepancies.
Some small-party columns are null in election years in which the party did not contest or was not separately reported.

column_definitions.ags: Eight-digit German municipality identifier on 2025 boundaries; stored as a string.
column_definitions.state: Two-digit German state identifier; stored as a string.
column_definitions.county: Five-digit county identifier; stored as a string.
column_definitions.election_year: Calendar year of the federal election.
column_definitions.number_voters: Harmonized number of voters, including invalid ballots.
column_definitions.turnout: number_voters divided by eligible_voters; proportion from 0 to 1.
column_definitions.turnout_wo_mailin: Turnout before allocation of shared mail-in districts; proportion from 0 to 1.
column_definitions.cdu_csu: Combined CDU/CSU vote share; proportion from 0 to 1.
column_definitions.far_right: Aggregate vote share for parties classified as far right by GERDA; proportion from 0 to 1.
column_definitions.far_left: Aggregate vote share for parties classified as far left, excluding Linke/PDS; proportion from 0 to 1.
column_definitions.far_left_w_linke: Aggregate far-left vote share including Linke/PDS; proportion from 0 to 1.
column_definitions.flag_naive_turnout_above_1: Indicator that the pre-correction turnout calculation exceeded 1.
column_definitions.flag_unsuccessful_naive_merge: Indicator that harmonization required a fallback rather than a direct crosswalk merge.
column_definitions.flag_total_votes_incongruent: Indicator that reconstructed total votes differ from reported valid votes.
column_definitions.total_votes: Sum of individual party vote columns.
column_definitions.population: Municipality population used or attached during harmonization.
